answer: Back in February your living room was pretty much empty except for a rug and a floor lamp, and you filled it with that IKEA Friheten futon since it doubled as a bed for your brother (the solo assembly your back never forgave). In August you replaced it with the $80 olive green velvet loveseat you grabbed from the guy in Verdun, doors off the hinges and cat hair everywhere. Then in December, after running out of seating with six guests, you ordered the grey modular sectional from Article and passed the loveseat on to your coworker.
